data.long_meaning: In the Bible, Fleece refers to a piece of woolen cloth that was used by Gideon to test God's will. The fleece was filled with dew while the ground remained dry, signifying God's approval. The name Fleece carries the meaning “Sheep's wool” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fleece usually hope their child will grow to embody sheep's wool and live with faith, good character and purpose.
